title: Farm soil report · Micro Tech Labs (October 2026)

extractionScope.description: Read the single soil sample on page 1, reference MTLR-0337/1010/26-27. Extract all six measured results. Keep the desirable limits column separate from results. Preserve total organic matter and total phosphorus/potassium as printed; do not relabel them organic carbon or available nutrients. Nitrogen form, test methods, depth and collection date are unreported. Received and reported dates are separate.

limitations: Sample for trying the review flow; it does not add measurements to the selected farm.
